history.summary: A well-known Shiva temple on Grand Trunk Road near Nirmal Kutiya Chowk, Sector 7, Karnal, with one main shikhar housing Lord Shiva and four surrounding shrines. Local tradition links it to Karna of the Mahabharata (Karnal is regarded as the city of Karna), but no founding date, builder, or inscriptional evidence is published (verify). A local belief holds that a stone displayed in water at the temple is one of the stones of the Ram Setu built by the Vanar Sena. Chief Minister Manohar Lal Khattar visited the temple for the Ram Mandir consecration celebrations in January 2024.

name: Shri Karneshwar Mahadev Temple
town_description: Karnal is a historic city in eastern Haryana on the Grand Trunk Road, traditionally associated with Karna of the Mahabharata and said to have been founded as Karnalaya by him. It is a major centre of agricultural research, hosting the National Dairy Research Institute, the Central Soil Salinity Research Institute, and the National Bureau of Animal Genetic Resources. The city is also the hometown of astronaut Kalpana Chawla, memorialised at the Kalpana Chawla Memorial Planetarium.

travel.airport: Chandigarh International Airport, about 125-130 km (verify); Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi, about 130 km (verify).
travel.railway: Karnal Junction railway station, about 3-4 km away (verify), on the Delhi-Ambala main line.
travel.road: On Grand Trunk Road (NH-44), Sector 7, near Nirmal Kutiya Chowk, within Karnal city; accessible by local transport.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Maha Shivratri and Shravan month draw the largest crowds
